description: Figures a household's 2026 federal income tax (Form 1040 line 24) and, given a state, its state income tax, from wages (with the Schedule 1-A overtime and tips deductions), children and other dependents, and other common income; and returns the Social Security and Medicare tax on the wages, the effective and marginal rates, the take-home pay, and, given withholding, the federal and state refund or amount owed, with the main lines of the return and every default assumed. Computed by QuantCalc's federal and state tax APIs, the engines the website's federal income tax, tax refund and salary-after-tax calculators are checked against to the cent. Requires a connected QuantCalc PRO licence or Tax Season Pass; without one it returns no figures and names the free web calculator. Not tax advice.

age.description: The age the filer reaches in 2026 (16-110).

charitable_cash.description: Cash gifts to charity in 2026. The engine keeps the lower tax of the standard and the itemized deduction. Default 0.

children_under_17.description: Qualifying children under 17 at the end of 2026: the child tax credit and the earned income credit. Default 0.

estimated_payments.description: Total 2026 federal estimated tax payments. With it (or federal_withholding) the result gives the federal refund or amount owed.

federal_withholding.description: Federal income tax withheld in 2026 (W-2 box 2, 1099s). With it (or estimated_payments) the result gives the federal refund or amount owed.

filing_status.description: 2026 filing status: single, married filing jointly (mfj), married filing separately (mfs) or head of household (hoh).

long_term_gains.description: 2026 net long-term capital gain (0 or more). Default 0.

mortgage_interest.description: Itemized deduction input: home mortgage interest paid in 2026. Default 0.

older_dependent_children.description: Dependent children aged 17 or 18, or full-time students under 24: the credit for other dependents and the earned income credit. Default 0.

ordinary_dividends.description: Ordinary dividends (Form 1099-DIV box 1a), including the qualified part. Default 0.

other_dependents.description: Other dependents (a parent or relative): the credit for other dependents only. Default 0.

pension.description: Taxable 2026 pension and annuity income (a private pension for the state's rules). Default 0.

qualified_dividends.description: The qualified part of ordinary_dividends; not more than it. Default 0.

qualified_overtime.description: Qualified overtime compensation included in the W-2 wages (the FLSA overtime premium only), deducted on Schedule 1-A. Not more than the wages. Default 0.

qualified_tips.description: Qualified tips included in the W-2 wages, deducted on Schedule 1-A. Not more than the wages. Default 0.

real_estate_tax_paid.description: Itemized deduction input: real estate tax paid in 2026. Default 0.

social_security.description: Gross 2026 Social Security benefits; the engine figures the taxable part. Default 0.

spouse_age.description: Joint return only: the age the spouse reaches in 2026. Default: the same as age, stated in the result.

spouse_wages.description: Joint return only: the spouse's own 2026 W-2 wages. Default 0.

state.description: Optional two-letter state of residence for 2026, or DC: adds the state income tax. Without it no state tax is figured.

state_local_income_tax_paid.description: Itemized deduction input: state and local income tax paid in 2026. Default 0.

state_withholding.description: State income tax withheld in 2026 (needs state). With it the result gives the state refund or amount owed.

wages.description: The filer's 2026 W-2 wages (box 1), including any overtime and tips. Default 0.

name: calculate_2026_income_tax
title: 2026 income tax, take-home pay and refund
